title: Easy flat run, Framura (sleep-in day)
terrain: Framura, flattest option (coastal path), no climbs
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 45min at 138-148bpm, flat, start after a natural wake-up (8h in bed). No spin possible, run only.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water. Carb-forward dinner, bed by 22:00, no alcohol (Sun long run).
GARMIN: ~30-40.
STOP RULE: under 6h sleep or HRV under 50 = 30min only.
WHY: sleep debt is the limiter, not HRV (59); this banks load without costing Sunday's legs (-135 vs old Sat 175).
